C-FIX-011-UNTITLED-CLOSE-ACTIONS.Name: Untitled close dialog: default Save & Close, separate Discard, visible Cancel
C-FIX-011-UNTITLED-CLOSE-ACTIONS.Summary: Replace the dirty-tab close confirmation that offered two discard-equivalent actions ("Discard & Close" and "Don't Save") with no visible Cancel by the owner-approved three-action model: Save & Close is the default (for an untitled tab it opens Save As and the tab closes only after the write succeeds), Discard is a separate non-default destructive action, and Cancel is a visible nondestructive action whose result Escape and the close glyph share.
C-FIX-011-UNTITLED-CLOSE-ACTIONS.ApprovalBasis: Owner declared FIX-011 a release blocker during the 2026-10-20 native review of bae95a97 and approved the action model verbatim; the exit gates are contracted in docs/release-trains/2.5.x-next-followups.md EP-02 (EP-2.5X-FOLLOWUPS-2026-10-20).
C-FIX-011-UNTITLED-CLOSE-ACTIONS.ProblemEvidence: src/renderer/src/store/editor.js CLOSE_UNSAVED_TAB on an untitled dirty tab: confirmButtonText "Discard & Close" (confirm → discard) and cancelButtonText "Don't Save" (cancel → discard) — both buttons discard and close; Escape and the X glyph are the only cancel paths and no Cancel button is visible. The named-file dialog shares the "Don't Save" discard labeling.

Goals.Goal: Three visible labeled actions with three distinct results; nothing labeled "Close"; no discard path is default.

Untitled Save & Close runs the Save As transport for the closing tab's own identity and closes only on a truthy outcome; cancelled and failed saves leave the tab and its content open, failures keep the notice.
Named files keep the mt::save-and-close-tabs payload path and working explicit discard.
Default and destructive styling asserted (accent vs delete colour), and the FIX-007 dark-theme coverage continues on the new surface.

Constraints.Constraint: Do not touch the LISTEN_FOR_CLOSE window-close batch dialog — its mixed named/untitled semantics need their own owner decision; recorded as a follow-up candidate, not silently changed.
Element Plus MessageBox cannot render three buttons: the dialog is a plain DOM module reusing the FIX-007 float tokens for light/dark parity.
English strings stay hardcoded as today (the current dialog is not localized either); localization is out of scope.
Existing named-file save & discard behavior is a regression boundary and must stay intact.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No window-close batch dialog redesign, no autosave change, no session-restore work (FIX-009).
No release action; admission waits for the owner's focused acceptance on the fresh isolated artifact.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Component coverage proves three visible labels, three distinct results, default focus on Save & Close, separated default/destructive styling, and Cancel-equivalence of Escape, the close glyph and a backdrop click.

Store coverage proves: named save sends mt::save-and-close-tabs; untitled save-as success applies the outcome and closes; a cancelled or failed Save As keeps the tab; Discard closes with no save transport; Cancel keeps the tab.
Browser coverage drives the real untitled flow through successful Save As, cancelled Save As, failed Save As, Discard, Cancel, Escape and the close glyph, plus the named regression boundary.
The dark-theme FIX-007 styling assertions pass on the new dialog surface with computed colours, not inference from button order.
